result.title: Low-Rank Kolmogorov-Arnold Generator Flows for Interpretable Operator Learning
result.summary: Neural operators that learn physical laws from data should generalize beyond their training distribution and expose the learned law in closed form. The Kolmogorov-Arnold neural operator achieves both for position-dependent dynamics by learning a dense pseudo-differential symbol over all positions and frequencies, at a cost that grows with the square of the resolution and with closed forms that must be read out by hand. This dense symbol is unnecessary: a finite-order variable-coefficient differential operator has a symbol whose separation rank is bounded by the number of its coefficient functions, independently of the resolution, and the symbols that this network learns on its own benchmarks have rank two. We introduce the Kolmogorov-Arnold flow (KAFlow), which learns the generator of a physical operator as a low-rank symbol built from univariate Kolmogorov-Arnold functions, fixes the gauge of these functions so that every term has a unique place, integrates the dynamics with exact exponential integrators, and distills its closed form automatically. On the synthetic benchmarks of the Kolmogorov-Arnold neural operator, KAFlow lowers the out-of-distribution loss by 3.4 to 11 times and recovers every coefficient to within 10^-4 without symbolic templates, reaching the precision floor of the data. On long-horizon quantum dynamics, it lowers the state infidelity by up to 6 orders of magnitude, and by 30 times when trained only on position and momentum measurements. KAFlow also learns a variable-order fractional operator 15 times more accurately than existing operator networks and discovers nonlocal, fractional and non-polynomial dispersion relations on which sparse regression fails.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 KAFlow，将物理算子的生成元表示为低秩符号，由一元 Kolmogorov-Arnold 函数构建并固定规范，配合精确指数积分器演化并可自动蒸馏出闭式表达，在 OOD 泛化与系数恢复上优于稠密符号神经算子。
AI.relevance_reason: 「生成元低秩、规范固定使每项有唯一位置、蒸馏闭式」的思路可能为 latent 推理状态更新的低秩结构与贡献分配提供分析视角，属推测性跨域启发，需核查是否适用于多模态推理状态。
